page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.se1.2xlarge is an x86_64 architecture server instance powered by an Intel Xeon 8163 processor running at 2.5 GHz. It features 8 dedicated physical cores with 1 thread per core, providing 8 vCPUs. The instance is equipped with 64.0 GB of RAM, yielding a high memory-to-vCPU ratio of 8.0 GB per core. It does not include local storage or GPU accelerators, and operates on a KVM hypervisor with a baseline network bandwidth of 2 Gbps.

Benchmark results indicate mixed performance across different workloads. The CPU shows weak single-core and multi-core capabilities in stress-ng and Geekbench tests, placing in the bottom 25%. However, memory bandwidth for large uncached blocks performs at an average level, though small-block cached reads and Passmark memory scores remain weak. Cryptographic and compression tasks, such as single-threaded gzip and bzip3, show poor performance in the bottom 10%. Redis SET operations and small-model LLM inference achieve average throughput, while larger model inference is poor.

Given its high memory density relative to compute power, this instance offers qualitative cost efficiency for memory-bound workloads that do not require intense CPU processing. The lack of local storage requires reliance on network-attached storage. It is best suited for memory-intensive applications such as caching layers, Redis databases, and lightweight data processing tasks where memory capacity is prioritized over raw computational speed.
